description: Look up US nonprofits and their IRS Form 990 financials via ProPublica's Nonprofit Explorer API.

novel_features.name: Name-or-EIN resolution
novel_features.description: org, filings, financials, people, and every compare argument accept a nonprofit NAME as well as an EIN; names auto-resolve to the top ProPublica search match with a Resolved note (stderr) or a resolved envelope field (--agent).

novel_features.name: Financial trajectory with YoY
novel_features.description: Year-by-year revenue/expense/net/asset table with year-over-year revenue change, plus latest-year revenue composition (contributions vs program vs investment vs other) and personnel-cost share of expenses.

novel_features.name: Side-by-side comparison
novel_features.description: Latest-990 side-by-side of two or more organizations (revenue, expenses, assets, NTEE, fiscal year), mixing names and EINs freely.

novel_features.name: NTEE-CC code naming
novel_features.description: Embedded 633-code NTEE-CC table renders human cause-area names (T23 -> Private Operating Foundations) in search, org, and JSON output; letter-level major-group fallback included.

novel_features.name: Officer compensation aggregates
novel_features.description: Per-year officer compensation total and share of expenses, other salaries & wages, payroll taxes, and professional fundraising fees from the IRS Form 990 extract, with per-year 990 PDF links for individual officer detail.
